description: This file implements backend APIs for the COSA Data Model Logging component, including creation, initialization, and removal of logging objects using C functions. It manages memory allocation for logging configurations and external APIs related to logging.

classes.name: COSA_DATAMODEL_LOGGING
classes.description: Structure representing the logging data model object, containing properties and method pointers for create, initialize, and remove operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE CosaLoggingCreate(VOID)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new logging data model object, setting up method pointers and calling its initialize function.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaLoggingInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the logging data model by allocating and fetching configuration data, setting up internal pointers.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CosaLoggingRemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Cleans up and frees memory associated with the logging data model object.
